meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,助手能通过 Signal 收发消息,以你扫描链接的现有手机号码作为身份,无需新号码。技能会安装 signal-cli、扫码链接账号,并把 Signal 频道接入 NanoClaw。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 通过 Signal 收发消息,或在初始化设置中需要添加 Signal 频道时触发。它会引导完成安装、扫码链接、授权用户等步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接到我的 Signal 账号上
say.note: 开始检查 signal-cli 并进入设备链接流程

say.text: 给我生成一个 Signal 扫码链接二维码
say.note: 运行认证步骤,显示二维码,约 3 分钟后过期

say.text: 把 Signal 频道添加到 NanoClaw 并接线
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并提示重启服务

howto.what_en: This skill adds a Signal channel to NanoClaw via a signal-cli device link, acting as a secondary device on an existing phone number. It installs signal-cli, guides through QR linking, and registers the adapter.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask NanoClaw to use Signal for messaging, or while setting up NanoClaw and adding a Signal channel. It walks through installing, linking your number, and granting user access.

say_en.text: Help me connect NanoClaw to my Signal account
Show me a QR code to link Signal
say_en.note: Runs auth step; QR expires in ~3 min.

say_en.text: Add Signal as a channel and wire it up
